title: South Africa write history while Neymar makes first appearance
summary: After a disastrous start at the World Cup, Bafana Bafana have qualified for the knockout stage for the first-ever time. The squad beat South Korea 1-0 in their last group stage game to reach the Round of 32. Meanwhile superstar Neymar came in as a substitute for Brazil to the delight of fans, as the team took top spot of Group C by beating Scotland 3-0.
